regions.contentLimits: One page header plus the full product brief rendered from the source document.
regions.overflow: Tables and preformatted blocks scroll horizontally inside their own keyboard-reachable region.

regions.contentLimits: Markdown headings h1 to h3, lists, tables, code, and rules.
regions.overflow: The forked table owns a named, focusable scroll region.

responsive.compact: Single column; tables and code blocks scroll horizontally.
responsive.wide: Content is capped at the reading measure and centered.

focus.onError: The route renders a server error boundary; focus stays on the document.

accessibility.headings: One h1 for the page, then the ordered headings of the brief itself.
accessibility.labels: Each scrollable table and code block is a named region.
